explanation: Compared against OEIS A196698, comment by Charles R Greathouse IV: 'I conjecture the contrary: infinitely many elements of this sequence are equal to 0.' The Lean statement {n | a n = 0}.Infinite is exactly this counter-conjecture (the junk member n = 0 does not affect infinitude). It contradicts conjecture_1, as on the OEIS page, where both are recorded as competing open conjectures. Faithful.
